caption: The drawing features a detailed, oval-shaped brass or gold-colored furniture handle, shown in two views: a front view and a side view. The front view occupies the left central portion of the page, depicting the handle as a horizontally oriented oval plate with a hinged pull that is attached at two circular mounts on each end. The central area of the plate is engraved with an image of a bird, possibly an eagle, with outstretched wings above a shield, set within an inner oval border. The side view, located to the right of the front view, shows the profile of the handle, including the thickness of the oval backplate and the protruding shape of the handle. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or cream color. At the bottom left, there is a small linear scale in inches, and at the bottom right, the name "JANET RIZA" is printed.
title: Drawer Pull
